text: player
Some People Will Compete All the Way to the Grave
Kaguyahime
Tsumo! 18,000 points!
Mahjong Soul Shrine - Mahjong Room
The Man
Aw, man...!
The Woman
I lost...
The Older Man
Alright, you got me, young lady.
Hehehe, then honor our agreement and join my ranks.//nFrom today on, you're all members of my Kiheitai!
Voice
Wait up, nyaa!
Hmm? Who's there?
Ichihime
It's me, nyaa!
Oh, Shorty.
Not Shorty, it's Ichihime, nyaa!
Gintoki Sakata
What are you doing?
Just playing some mahjong. Win, and you'll be rewarded. Lose, and you'll be under my command. Those are the rules.
What are you planning to do with all these people?
Hehehe... Why not take a guess?
To hold a festival.
You're planning to defeat Ichihime with numbers, aren't you? And then... step by step... conquer the world...!
...It seems that Shorty's nonsense is starting to rub off on you, too.
What's that supposed to mean, nyaa?!
Foolish mortals... I shall grace you with my wisdom out of sheer mercy.
You're planning to hold a festival at the Mahjong Soul Shrine!
Hehehe... quite the opposite.
I shall reduce the Mahjong Soul Shrine to ruins!
Nyaa?!
Reduce the Mahjong Soul Shrine... to ruins?!
I met someone. His words made me realize... I don't really need to fight Shorty to take over the Mahjong Soul Shrine.
All I need to do is destroy the old shrine, and build a new one, solely for me! That's why I've gathered these expendable mortals.
You can just build a shrine somewhere else, nyaa!
Unacceptable. That would mean I've admitted defeat! I refuse to do so!
You stupid rabbit! That's enough out of you, nyaa!
Oi, Kaguyahime, right? The guy you met, did he also say something like this?
"I'll simply destroy it. This rotten world."
Hmm? You two know each other?
Where is he? I need to see him.
No idea. That man's too elusive. Who knows where he could be?
Right, he's been an expert at hide-and-seek since we were kids...
What is it, Gin?
Come out. Stop hiding.
To sense my presence by aura alone... Your instincts haven't dulled too much, I see.
Shinsuke Takasugi
It's been a while, Gintoki.
So the last of the Scoundrel Three really is you. Trying to form a little gang even in another world, huh? You just can't stand to be alone, can you?
That has nothing to do with me. She's acting on her own.
Hehehe, but I asked, didn't I? "Can I borrow the Kiheitai name?" And you told me to do as I please.
Doesn't matter. I came for you, Takasugi.
Word is there have been numerous attacks nearby. You know anything about that?
If you're responsible, then I'll have to ask you to leave.//nThis peaceful city has no room for troublemakers.
So, Takasugi. Let's hear it.
So what if I am? I don't owe you any answers.
I do as I please. Want me gone? Prove your strength.
Hmph, I knew it would come to this. Guess we're doing this the hard way.
Feels like Gin's become another person...
You could cut the tension between them with a knife, nyaa!
Bring it on, Gintoki!
Wait! No fighting in One Han City!
Gintoki Sakata & Shinsuke Takasugi
How about you two settle this with mahjong instead?
Mahjong? Ichihime's in, nyaa!
Hehehe, no mahjong game can go without me.
Fair enough. After all, this is a city where there isn't a single problem that mahjong can't resolve.
I'm in. Takasugi, you?
Guess there's no way around it... Let's settle this today.
Are you actually taking forever?
Stop hesitating, nyaa.
Quiet! It's called "planning before acting." Amateurs rush, but a real pro knows you have to wait for the perfect moment to strike.//nAnd that's why I'm playing this tile!
Hehehe, looks like you've given up on winning.
You're being too defensive, nyaa.
Told you to stop nagging me!
Tsumo, Baiman.
Huh?!
Looks like the fate is with me.
Damn it...
Gin, how many points you got left?
Zero...
It's over now.
Oi oi, what are you talking about? The real fight is just getting started!
(Gin!)
(Huh?)
(Gin!!)
(That voice...?!)
Heheheh...
What's with the sudden laughing?
Probably driven insane, nyaa?
No I'm not! Look what I found!
Is that a... scoring stick?
And just like that, it's in my arms.
Shinpachi Shimura (Scoring Stick)
Oi oi oi! Why did I turn into a scoring stick?!
Wait, did you hear that?
Probably just your imagination.
It's NOT an imagination! I'm right here! In the form of a scoring stick!!!
Shh! Shut it, Shinpachi. Your 1,000 points might just save my life.//nFrom now on, you're not glasses anymore, you're a scoring stick! So stay as you are, body and soul!!
Shinpachi Shimura (Scoring Stick)
But I don't want to be either of those things!
Is he... talking to the scoring stick...?
I don't get it, nyaa. But bringing your own scoring stick is cheating, nyaa.//nMr. Takasugi, what now, nyaa?
Hmph, makes no difference to me. He can't turn the tide even with that extra scoring stick.
Enough talking. You'll need more than just pretty words to turn this around.
Then watch closely! Let's go!
This is it!
Nyaaaaaa! I lost, nyaa!!
That was a heart-pounding game...
But! I'm the one who gets the last laugh! A glorious victory for me! Hehehehe!
Oi oi! Who asked?! This was supposed to be a showdown between me and Takasugi!

Utter nonsense! Mahjong is a true test of skill – once it begins, no mercy shall be shown.//nNot that I need to stoop to competing with Shorty, but trampling her underfoot to claim first place is simply divine!
Enough with the "shorty" already, nyaa! You Stupid Rabbit!!//nSo Mr. Takasugi placed second, Gin third. Wait, so... technically Mr. Takasugi won, nyaa?
I couldn't care less, but someone here clearly can't accept it.
Duh, what kinda win is that since you didn't come in first?! Another game!
As you wish.
Hehehe, what a delightful sore loser.
I could play all night, nyaa!

(That said – what the hell am I supposed to do now?!!! I don't even have enough points to go for a Riichi! I'd do anything for just one scoring stick... Is it too much to ask for one to pop out of nowhere?!!!)
To take down Ichihime.
We make the plans, and fate decides the outcome. Those fate turns its back on can only flounder in the muck like worms.
Well, who knows? This isn't just any scoring stick – it's a scoring stick with soul!
